# Astro SEO Theme

> The ultimate open-source Astro theme for B2B/SaaS marketing websites with advanced SEO, GEO & AEO optimization.

## About
Astro SEO Theme is an open-source website template built with Astro, Tailwind CSS, and React. It is specifically designed to provide perfect Lighthouse scores, Semantic HTML, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) out of the box.

## Key Technical Features
- Built on Astro 5.0 and Tailwind CSS v4.
- Generates 100/100 Lighthouse SEO and Accessibility scores.
- Implements comprehensive Schema.org JSON-LD structured data.
- Includes a fully responsive, CSS-only megamenu and zero-JS mobile navigation.
- Native multi-language (i18n) support with automatic `hreflang` tag generation.
